integrity: General statements supported by a symbolic dyad and two-state transition proof; separate standard-Python finite enumeration checks small fields and dimensions, not all parameters. No independent audit or validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Products of nonzero rank-one square-zero factors only; higher-rank square-zero factors, simultaneous-conjugation orbits and commuting-factor restrictions are outside the claim. Literature priority is subject to residual uncertainty for inaccessible full texts.
title: Complete product fibers and trace mixing of rank-one square-zero matrices
